findings.title: Percent formatting repeated at ~15 App sites with inconsistent rounding (notification title truncates 92.9 to 92, cards round)
findings.evidence: Remaining half of CQ-MAE-004 (raised by Higia and Jano, remediation B16)
findings.fix: One shared percent formatter used by cards, tooltip and notification title
findings.impact: Notification can show 1 point less than the card
findings.origin: new_findings from review panel, remediation B16

findings.title: lastNetworkFetch = .now reads the wall clock next to the injected clock; default clock is not monotonic
findings.evidence: Two time sources in one refresh path; a backwards wall-clock jump shortens the measured request duration (raised by Higia and Nemesis, remediation B16)
findings.fix: Use self.clock() consistently; consider ContinuousClock for elapsed time
findings.impact: Minor: testability and a rare shorter cooldown on clock jumps
findings.origin: new_findings from review panel, remediation B16

findings.title: Cached agy path treats only status == ERROR as an error while the live path also treats a non-empty error with another status as an error
findings.evidence: Pre-existing divergence noted by Nemesis, remediation B16
findings.fix: Share one predicate between live and cached paths
findings.impact: A cached envelope with error text and non-ERROR status may render as data
findings.origin: new_findings from review panel, remediation B16

findings.title: Failed-delivery unmark drops the key instead of restoring the previously delivered lower mark, so a later lower reading can re-send an already delivered threshold
findings.evidence: 70 delivered, 90 failed, next reading 75 re-sends 70 (raised by Nemesis, remediation B16 r2)
findings.fix: Keep the prior mark and restore it on failure
findings.origin: new_findings from review panel, remediation B16 r2

findings.title: With notification permission denied, every tick above a threshold makes one failed add() and one error-level log line indefinitely
findings.evidence: unmark re-arms after notificationsNotAllowed (raised by Higia and Jano, remediation B16 r2)
findings.fix: Skip re-arming (or downgrade the log) when authorization is known denied
findings.impact: ~12 error log lines per hour per window
findings.origin: new_findings from review panel, remediation B16 r2

findings.title: gemini.prefer_antigravity, xai.prefer_grok_cli and xai.grok_base_url have no Settings UI controls (config-file-only)
findings.evidence: Settings-UI half of CQ-MAE-011 intentionally not done (raised by Jano, remediation B16 r2)
findings.fix: Accept as config-file-only knobs, or add Settings controls
findings.impact: Users must edit config.toml for these keys
findings.origin: new_findings from review panel, remediation B16 r2
